items.text: Deshaun Watson has started all seven games and remains the Browns' starter.

Cleveland (Wednesday): EDGE Jared Verse (knee), C Elgton Jenkins (knee) and OT Tytus Howard (concussion) did not practice; LB Carson Schwesinger (ankle), DT Mason Graham (ankle), DT Mike Hall Jr. (ankle), RB Dylan Sampson (knee) and S Grant Delpit (neck) were limited.

Pittsburgh (Wednesday): CB Jalen Ramsey (wrist), CB Brandin Echols (hamstring) and DB Doneiko Slaughter (hamstring) did not practice (Watt, Heyward, Washington rested); EDGE Alex Highsmith (groin) and WR Ben Skowronek (calf) were limited. WR Michael Pittman Jr. is on IR.
